clauses.text:
EXECUTIVE ORDER 10671  
F leet Admiral Ernest J. K ing
As a mark of respect to the memory of  
Fleet Admiral Ernest J. King, it is hereby  
ordered, pursuant to the provisions of  
Section 4 of Proclamation 3044 of March  
1, 1954, that until interment the flag of  
the United States shall be flown at half-  
staff on all buildings, grounds, and naval  
vessels of the Federal Government in the  
District of Columbia and throughout the  
United States and its Territories and  
possessions.
